_meta.purpose: Ordered backlog of genuine, pre-authored improvements for github.com/hyeonjoong/debussy. The runner reveals ONE item at a time on a natural, irregular cadence (see ci_runner.py) so real work accumulates organically rather than on a rigid schedule.
_meta.policy: Every item is a real change whose diff matches its message and is backed by a verified file under .github/auto-commit/scaffolds/<target>. The runner never fabricates content: no comment stamps, no @pytest.mark.skip stubs. Test items are self-validating (the workflow runs pytest before committing). When this backlog is exhausted the runner simply stops; add more items with matching scaffolds/ files, or let real development drive the history.
_meta.scheduler: Daily cron; each day a weekday-weighted, date-seeded coin flip decides whether to reveal the next item, with a floor that forces a commit after 5 quiet days so the commit-heartbeat (7-day threshold) never trips while the backlog has items.
_meta.history_note: 2026-07-14: converted stub tests to real tests, implemented the stubbed features for real, fixed a spectral_slope crash, and moved from a rigid Tue/Fri week-index plan to this natural-cadence backlog.
